name_reason: Trailing _52388 is the symbol's own data address (0x52388), a Ghidra address residue that must be stripped per naming rules. The base data_fd2_string_resource_filename_figani_dat already matches the data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention and reflects both the content (the FIGANI.DAT resource filename) and the data type (a resource-filename string). It is exactly consistent with the established sibling symbol data_fd2_string_resource_filename_tai_dat at 0x52393 (which carries no address suffix). purpose: Read-only ASCII string literal "FIGANI.DAT" (the resource archive filename) used as the char* path argument to fd2_load_dat_resource for opening the character figure-animation archive.
logic_summary: Static const char[11] = {'F','I','G','A','N','I','.','D','A','T',0}. Its address is taken (PUSH 0x52388 / array decays to char*) and passed as the first argument to fd2_load_dat_resource by seven combat/spell/skill cinematic routines. Each reader loads a pair of per-character indices: portrait_id*3 -> silhouette/skeleton sprite, and portrait_id*3+1 -> a per-character animation byte stream (pose count + per-pose SFX-hook/hold-tick metadata). Never written. Immediately follows "BG.DAT" @ 0x52381 and precedes "TAI.DAT" @ 0x52393 in the string pool.
element_semantics: ASCII bytes of the DOS 8.3 filename "FIGANI.DAT" followed by a NUL terminator (11 bytes total). Forms a C string consumed as a resource-archive path.
notes: Data plate at 0x52388 was empty (null); created a concise PLATE_COMMENT matching the established sibling style at 0x52381 (BG.DAT) - read-only resource filename, reader list, index pairing (portrait_id*3 / *3+1), never written, pool adjacency.
